query: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT laptop_id FROM orders WHERE laptop_id IS NOT NULL AND is_active=1 AND order_status NOT IN ('cancelled','returned') AND payment_status<>'refunded' GROUP BY laptop_id HAVING count(*)>1)) AS multiple_active_orders,(SELECT count(*) FROM orders o JOIN laptops l ON l.id=o.laptop_id WHERE o.is_active=1 AND o.order_status IN ('prepared','shipping','done') AND l.status<>'sold') AS committed_not_sold,(SELECT count(*) FROM laptops l WHERE status='sold' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.laptop_id=l.id AND o.is_active=1 AND o.order_status IN ('prepared','shipping','done'))) AS sold_without_committed_order,(SELECT count(*) FROM orders o JOIN laptops l ON l.id=o.laptop_id WHERE o.is_active=1 AND o.order_status NOT IN ('cancelled','returned') AND l.status IN ('waiting_qc','repair','supplier_return','in_transit','ignored')) AS active_order_technical_state

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM orders o WHERE abs(COALESCE(o.amount_paid,0)-COALESCE((SELECT sum(CASE WHEN payment_type='refund' THEN -amount ELSE amount END) FROM payments WHERE order_id=o.id),0))>0.000001) AS paid_ledger_drift,(SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE abs(debt_amount-max(sale_price-amount_paid-COALESCE(trade_in_credit_vnd,0)/1000000,0))>0.000001) AS debt_drift,(SELECT count(*) FROM payments p WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM financial_records f WHERE f.payment_id=p.id)<>1) AS payment_financial_cardinality,(SELECT count(*) FROM payments p WHERE p.account_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM account_transactions t WHERE t.reference_type='PAYMENT' AND t.reference_id=CAST(p.id AS TEXT) AND abs(t.amount-round(p.amount*1000000))<0.5)) AS cash_link_or_amount_drift

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE order_status IN ('prepared','shipping','done') AND cost_snapshotted_at IS NULL) AS committed_missing_snapshot,(SELECT count(*) FROM orders o JOIN laptops l ON l.id=o.laptop_id WHERE abs(o.profit_vnd-(o.sale_price-l.import_price_vnd))>0.0001) AS current_profit_drift,(SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE cost_snapshotted_at IS NOT NULL AND abs(gross_profit_snapshot_vnd-(sale_price*1000000-cost_snapshot_vnd))>0.5) AS snapshot_current_sale_difference,(SELECT count(*) FROM laptops WHERE source_type IN ('SUPPLIER_PURCHASE','SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT') AND (price_rmb IS NOT purchase_price_rmb OR exchange_rate IS NOT purchase_exchange_rate)) AS procurement_alias_drift

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM laptops WHERE status IS NULL OR is_active IS NULL) AS null_laptop_state,(SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE order_status IS NULL OR payment_status IS NULL OR is_active IS NULL) AS null_order_state,(SELECT count(*) FROM laptops l WHERE l.status='available' AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM repair_jobs r WHERE r.laptop_id=l.id AND r.status NOT IN ('COMPLETED','CANCELLED')) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM supplier_return_items r WHERE r.laptop_id=l.id AND r.status NOT IN ('REFUNDED','REPLACED','REJECTED','CANCELLED')))) AS available_with_active_technical_case,(SELECT count(*) FROM account_transactions t JOIN cash_accounts a ON a.id=t.account_id WHERE t.currency<>a.currency) AS account_currency_mismatch

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM account_transactions t JOIN cash_accounts a ON a.id=t.account_id WHERE (t.occurred_at>=a.opening_balance_at)<>(julianday(t.occurred_at)>=julianday(a.opening_balance_at))) AS lexical_time_balance_mismatch,(SELECT count(*) FROM purchase_batches b JOIN purchase_batch_summaries v ON v.id=b.id WHERE b.status<>v.status) AS batch_status_projection_difference,(SELECT count(*) FROM supplier_returns r WHERE COALESCE((SELECT sum(amount_rmb) FROM supplier_refunds f WHERE f.supplier_return_id=r.id),0)>COALESCE((SELECT sum(COALESCE(agreed_refund_rmb,expected_refund_rmb,0)) FROM supplier_return_items i WHERE i.supplier_return_id=r.id AND i.status<>'CANCELLED'),0)) AS over_refund
